_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY - this file is not read from here. Copy it to
this one) and replace /ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/contributor-scout with the real
path to this checkout. Read hooks/README.md first - it blocks git commit,
git push, gh write commands, and writes outside contribution-discovery/,
which will interfere with ordinary development work in the same session.
Do NOT place this file at .agents/hooks.json inside the contributor-scout
checkout itself - Antigravity auto-loads workspace hooks from there, and
the placeholder script path below does not exist yet.
This hook matters more on Antigravity than on the other hosts: the bundled
custom agents ship with commandExecutionPolicy: auto so that read-only git
and gh commands run without a prompt for every query.
